text.p: These are the leading stories in the Lebanese press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Two pro-Israeli South Lebanon Army militiamen killed in two separate bomb attacks in south Lebanon and Israeli warplanes raid suspected Hizbollah guerrilla targets.
- Lebanese officials in Zaire and South Africa reach agreement with Zairean rebels to release 46 Lebanese Nationals held hostage.
- Constitutional Council will resume meetings on Monday without its chief, who resigned last month.
- Prime Minister Hariri receives Russia's deputy foreign minister for second time in four days.
- Government does its best to remove Elias Abu Rizk from his position as chief of General Confederation of Labour. CGTL elections will be held on Thursday.
- 125 Lebanese nationals arrive in Beirut after escaping Zaire's civil war.
- Minister of Economy Jaber says Lebanon establishes joint economic committees with Russia and Canada.
